system.description:
Half craftsman, half conjurer, binding glamours into rings, lenses and cloaks.

  • Bound Glamour: During a rest, bind one Glamour trick you know into a trinket. Once per day, whoever carries it may use that trick from it at no Glamour cost, using your Class Save DC.
    • 9th level: you can keep two trinkets bound at once.
  • Trader's Eye: Advantage on checks to appraise, identify or haggle over magic items, and to pass off a mundane item as magical or a magic one as mundane.
